Goal
* The statement uses two notations:
  • level: 0, -1, -2, …
  • depth: 0, 1, 2, …
  but never formally defines depth.

  Please define the relationship between level and depth (e.g. depth is the absolute value of level).

* For clarity of the formula, please revise the description as follows:

  • Add "[[b]] and a depth [[d]]" after "has a base load".

  • Change "down:" to "down. The load contributed by the room is calculated as:"

  • Replace the formula "load = base × 2^depth" with "[[b]] × {{2}}^[[d]]".

* Please format the six room names and the numbers 1 to 6 (*exclude* the equal signs) as {{constants}}.

Input & Constraints
* Please format "(" and ")" as {{constants}}.

Constraints
* Please change 14 to 1, and 65 to 99.

* Please add:

The parentheses in [[S]] are always balanced and never appear at the beginning of [[S]].

Stub generator
* Please change 65 to 99.

Thanks.
Normally it's supposed to be fixed, thanks again 5DN1L 👍
